name: Mytherceria — 3 Advanced — Elder Mytherceria: Steal the Mind

system.description: Through eye contact and a Willpower Trait, win a Mental Challenge to gain full temporary access to a victim's memories, rendering him comatose or torporous while you hold them; you may extend the duration by spending more Willpower, but you also suffer Oblivious penalties from carrying two minds.
system.duration: One hour per Willpower Trait spent
